_comment: In-game measurements for tools/build_bis.py (load_measured). samples: what the self-test's AMISIA-WERTE line says (parse_werte; add one with build_bis.py --werte "<line>"; 'line' keeps the original). A rating pair (rating, bonus %) pins the rating per percent of its kind. Agility or intellect per percent crit and the base crit (crit at none of the stat, talents included) are pinned only by two samples of the same class and level with different agility (intellect), e.g. the same character with an item taken off; a single point is listed as unpinned and changes nothing. A class nobody measured takes the mean factor of the measured ones (Classic's curve times that factor). overrides: direct values that win over derived ones (rating60, agiPerCritScale, intPerCritScale, baseCrit, baseSpellCrit, manaPerSpirit5).
